pieces.Text: When the Yethazmari howls or barks, each creature within a 300-foot-radius spread must succeed at a DC 25 Will save or be panicked for 2d4 rounds. This is a sonic mind-affecting fear effect. Evil outsiders are immune to this ability. Whether or not it succeeds at its save, a creature in the area is immune to the Yethazmari's bay for 24 hours. The save DC is Charisma-based.
